basic_details.job_title: IMSc Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Associate, Research Associate and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Project Associate - I, Research Associate - I, Project Technical Assistant [Level-II]

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Four year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences or Engineering or Technology, Ph.D in Physics / Mathematics / Computer Science / Quantum Science / Engineering or Technology, Diploma in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 55% marks
qualification.details: Project Associate - I: Four year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences or Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent. Candidates having qualified a national-level examination such as CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, JAM or equivalent shall be eligible for higher remuneration. Desirable: Background in Quantum Computing. At least 2 years relevant research experience. Research Associate - I: Ph.D in Physics / Mathematics / Computer Science / Quantum Science / Engineering or Technology / a relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent. Or candidates who have submitted their Ph.D thesis and / defended the thesis and awaiting award of the Ph.D. degree. Desirable: Background in QMP, Computational Physics. Project Technical Assistant [Level-II]: Diploma in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 55% marks from a reputed college/institution approved by Government / Board of Technical Education / AICTE, with minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in operation and maintenance of 11 kV/433 V electrical substations and associated systems. Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate (C-License) issued by CEIG, Govt. Desirable: Working knowledge of Linux, AutoCAD and LibreOffice.

salary_details.details: Project Associate - I: Rs. 31,500/- per month Research Associate - I: Rs. 73,500/- per month (or Rs. 53,000/- per month) Project Technical Assistant [Level-II]: Rs. 32,500/- per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IMSc Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IMSc Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IMSc Project Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IMSc Project Positions is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Positions at IMSc?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Project Positions at The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate - I, a four-year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences or Engineering or Technology is required. Qualifying national-level exams like CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or JAM is also beneficial.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these IMSc positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Project Positions at IMSc is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IMSc Project Positions recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for IMSc Project Positions involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for a Research Associate - I at IMSc?
faq.answer: The salary for a Research Associate - I at IMSc is Rs. 73,500/- per month, or Rs. 53,000/- per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any experience required for the Project Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Project Technical Assistant [Level-II] position, a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in operation and maintenance of 11 kV/433 V electrical substations is required.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply through any mode other than email?
faq.answer: As per the notification, the application mode for these positions is strictly via email. No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or by visiting the official website of The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc).
